title: kvquant: tested KV-cache quantization for Hugging Face transformers, with MI300X serving benchmarks
description: Open-source int8/int4 KV-cache quantization for Hugging Face transformers 5.x with a silent-no-op stress test, plus the November 2026 AMD MI300X benchmark suite: paired LongBench accuracy under vLLM serving load (loadqa.py) and a label-free serving-invariance fuzzer (invfuzz.py) that detects batch-dependent accuracy bugs.
